name: Glaskunst-Workshop in Kramsach
beschreibung:
The Alpbachtal region forms the historic epicentre of glass craftsmanship in Austria. While Kramsach hosts the HTL Kramsach Glass College – the only vocational glassmaking school in Austria –, the adjacent medieval town of Rattenberg (the smallest town in Austria) is renowned worldwide as the „Town of Glass", teeming with open craft studios, engravers, and glassblowers.

Workshops & Experiences

The premier interactive guest experience is the guest glassblowing at Kisslinger Kristall-Glas (Südtirolerstraße 24, Rattenberg). Under the direct supervision of master glassblowers, visitors step up to the 1,400 °C furnace to blow their own colourful decorative glass bauble or garden watering globe using an authentic pipe. The hands-on session takes roughly 5 minutes, followed by a 20- to 30-minute cooling period before taking home the finished piece and certificate. Price: approx. €18 per piece. Running from May to October, every Monday and Friday afternoon (no reservation needed for individuals).

Visitors can also watch master craftsmen at work across traditional studios including Glas Schwarz, Kristallglas Schlenz, and Glasatelier Henkel, observing delicate glass cutting, diamond engraving, and fusing techniques. Custom engravings can be inscribed directly onto souvenir glassware on demand. The HTL Glass School in Kramsach runs specialized multi-day summer masterclasses in August.

Season & Opening: Glass galleries and live demonstration workshops operate year-round Monday to Saturday. Admission to the demonstration glassblowing arena at Kisslinger is free.

Getting There

Rattenberg is a designated pedestrian zone. Pay-and-display car parks (P1–P5) surround the town boundary (payable via machine or EasyPark app, with the first hour free via the app). By train: The ÖBB regional railway station Rattenberg-Kramsach is a brief 3- to 5-minute stroll from the town gates. Connecting buses serve the glass school in Kramsach.

Tips

  • Families: Glassblowing is suitable for children aged 3+ with hands-on assistance from the glass artisan.
  • Dogs: Permitted on leash throughout the pedestrian town; less suitable inside tight hot-furnace demo areas.
  • Card Perks: The Alpbachtal Card offers discounts on glass purchases and free regional bus transit.
